field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: The exact model declaration prevents a legacy smoke model entering comparisons.
field_principles.arm_config_rows: Arm contracts make read and write authority explicit before inference.
field_principles.budget_rows: Matched assigned budgets prevent compute differences from posing as learning.
field_principles.checkpoint_rows: Durable stage receipts prove prompt and raw bytes precede outcome access.
field_principles.chronological_gain_over_readonly: Paired later successes measure learning rather than write volume.
field_principles.commit_rows: Commit receipts bind each active update to parent and new state hashes.
field_principles.duration_s: Total wall time exposes incomplete or synthetic execution.
field_principles.event_order_hash: The order digest detects event reordering that could change learning credit.
field_principles.exact_outcome_rows: Independent exact outcomes keep model self-reports outside authority.
field_principles.experiment_id: A fixed task identity prevents evidence from another run entering the result.
field_principles.field_principles: A reason for each field makes the scientific contract reviewable.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Expected and observed values make any blocked prerequisite actionable.
field_principles.held_future_rows: Held-future pairs measure later utility after the six-event learning prefix.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A class-consistent terminal prefix gives downstream automation a stable state.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The substrate declares local Qwen generation plus external policy state.
field_principles.leakage_check_rows: Leakage checks keep confidence and later outcomes outside prompts and writes.
field_principles.live_duration_s: Model-call time separates live generation from exact checking and storage.
field_principles.max_forgetting: The largest cumulative lost-success count exposes catastrophic forgetting.
field_principles.memory_lookup_rows: Lookup receipts show which earlier policy records could affect each call.
field_principles.memory_state_bytes: Exact bytes enforce the preregistered small-state budget.
field_principles.model_file_hashes: Weight hashes detect silent model-byte changes during the run.
field_principles.models_used: The observed roster proves which model produced the compared rows.
field_principles.per_event_results: Paired event summaries expose wins, losses, and ties without pooling.
field_principles.plasticity_score: Recurring-error recovery measures adaptation to newly observed failures.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Explicit gates stop live calls when required evidence or tools are absent.
field_principles.prompt_visibility_rows: Visibility receipts prove each prompt uses predecessor-only evidence.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed seed sequence makes matched stochastic calls addressable.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A timing-free digest detects drift in plans, outputs, and reductions.
field_principles.restart_recovery_rows: Fresh-store receipts prove interrupted prepares and final state recover.
field_principles.rollback_rows: Rollback receipts prove harmful state can return to exact parent bytes.
field_principles.rows: All 72 terminal units are the authority for aggregate claims.
field_principles.run_date: The execution date distinguishes this protocol run from earlier blocked attempts.
field_principles.schema: A versioned schema lets a cold audit reject incompatible rows.
field_principles.self_learning_run_complete_score: One requires all rows, matched budgets, replay, and leakage checks.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Hashes bind the run to exact upstream evidence bytes.
field_principles.stability_score: Retention of read-only successes measures resistance to harmful change.
field_principles.stream_hash: One digest binds the selected chronological fixture stream.
field_principles.transaction_journal_rows: Hash-linked phases prove prepare became durable before commit.
field_principles.transactional_learning_positive_score: One requires two later gains, no losses, rollback, and bounded state.
field_principles.update_proposal_rows: Proposal rows show that writes use only allowed post-outcome fields.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed class prevents a completed null from being reported as positive.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False states that the memory policy is distinct from the exact evaluator.
